CREATE FUNCTION OM.FUNC_CHECK_STATUS(@task_name [varchar](100),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime])
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
		COUNT(*) CNT_SUCCESSFUL
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
	INNER JOIN
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS	
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID=OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTR.TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name) AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date AND 
		OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
);
